fields.title: Exterior water and rewetting
fields.finding: The 0.1 kg/m² exterior term is an allowance, not a measured retained film. Extra preexisting-water comparisons are arithmetic; no wet-start evaporation or drainage was solved. Interior absorption may recover after baking.
fields.missing_evidence: Drainage, water uptake, seal moisture and repeated-night exposure tests.
